featured_reviews.review_text:
Would not recommend purchasing this product at all.

Yes, the cloth quality is decent, but that means absolutely nothing when the product itself fails to serve its purpose properly. The sizing/design clearly seems made only for people under 5 feet tall (I'm 5.5"), yet this was nowhere mentioned on the website before purchase. Important details are conveniently hidden while the brand aggressively advertises on Instagram just to push sales.

What makes this worse is that it’s a prepaid-only website, so the company gets your money upfront and then leaves you stranded when there’s an issue. The moment you raise a genuine concern, the response is basically: “our vendor is fixed,” which translates to — we got your money, now deal with it yourself. No refund, no exchange, no actual solution.

For the premium prices they charge, the greed is very obvious. The focus seems to be more on aggressive marketing and collecting payments than providing transparency, accountability, or proper customer support.

Buy only if you’re willing to risk wasting your money on an overpriced product and a company that disappears the moment you need help.

featured_reviews.review_text: I had a wonderful shopping experience at The Bombay Store in R City Mall, Ghatkopar West. A big shoutout to Ritu and Deepali, who were incredibly friendly and helpful. Great vibes, lovely staff, and unique collection. Highly recommend visiting!

featured_reviews.name: Pallavi Kampani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Just wanted to compliment the team at Bombay store, Ghatkopar R City Mall . Once again, we came out overwhelmed by the experience. The collection is really wonderful, and so is the staff.
I'd gone there today with my parents and they were really happy with the gifts they picked up for their friends to take back home.. They simply loved the colourful, and very Indian prints. Not to mention the price range.
The staff too is very courteous and helpful. I've noticed that in my earlier trips too. They are there to help you when you need help, but they let the customer have their own space, and take there own time, never over pushy. Hats off! 👏🏽👏🏽👏🏽👍🏼👍🏼👍🏼

featured_reviews.name: nihar desai
featured_reviews.review_text:
Re: Ghatkopar RCity Mall store:
In the past until 1 year ago - staff members were generally polite, attentive - and were approachable. Since last year there have been few changes, and we noticed that the atmosphere in the store has changed. Currently - during our two recent visits - we walked out feeling  disappointed. Staff members are chatting to one another - they look at you and carry on - customer does not matter. Bad attitude. A lady staff member has an attitude, she seems to have joined recently. Was not there until last year, and she especially appears to find it tedious to answer any query ( gives a vibe ----"unwanted customer.")Somehow, both times we did not like the approach. We loved Bombay store, but now we do not wish to go there anylonger, and wanted to leave this review. We walked out without buying anything - just did not want to look... Very bad vibes.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
🙏 Namaste from The Bombay Store 🙏

Thank you for taking time to leave us a review. We truly appreciate your feedback.

Support Swadeshi!

featured_reviews.name: AMIT BACHHAWAT
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently had the pleasure of experiencing exceptional service at R City Mall stores, and I wanted to express my gratitude. The salesperson Ritu  went beyond to assist me in finding the perfect product. Her dedication and willingness to go out of their way to ensure I had a great shopping experience even though virtually sitting in Bangalore were truly outstanding. This level of customer service is rare to find, and it has left a lasting positive impression. Thank you for having such dedicated and customer-focused employees. I will definitely be returning to your store and recommending it to friends and family
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Mr. Bachhawat,

Namaste from The Bombay Store!

Our Handicraft Heroes will be delighted to hear your kind words.

Thank you for your continued patronage.

Team - Bombay Store
